fields.name: ipass
fields.description: A random string of 12 characters. The HTTP check-in of the official client sends it back.

fields.name: home
fields.description: The home server of the character, `player.p.home`: region plus server name, for example `"EUI"`.

fields.name: friends
fields.description: The friend list of the account: the user ids of the friends (node/server.js:11632).

fields.name: acx
fields.description: The cosmetics that the account owns: cosmetic name to count.

fields.name: xcx
fields.description: A list of cosmetic names. The server only sets it to `[]` (node/server_functions.js:4448). The official client adds the free cosmetics of the class.

fields.name: info
fields.description: `instance.info` of the instance of the character. Usually `{}`. A duel instance has `{seconds, active, A, B, id}` (node/server.js:12238-12246). The `tavern` has `{dice, num, seconds}`. A dream cave floor has `{zone}` (see Notes).

fields.name: base_gold
fields.description: `D.base_gold`: monster type to map name to the base gold of one kill (node/server_functions.js:231-232).

fields.name: s_info
fields.description: The server event state `E`, the same object as the `server_info` payload.

fields.name: blessed_by
fields.description: Only while the server has a blessing: the character that paid for it.

fields.name: blessed_minutes
fields.description: Only while the server has a blessing: the minutes that remain.

fields.name: code
fields.description: When `auth` loaded code from a code slot: the source code text. It replaces the `code` flag of `player_to_client` (node/server.js:11937-11941). Otherwise it is that flag.

fields.name: code_slot
fields.description: Only with the code text: the code slot that the server found for `auth.code_slot`, as a string.

fields.name: code_version
fields.description: Only with the code text: the save count of that code slot.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: An `entities` payload with `type: "all"` for the start position (`send_all_xy(player, {raw: true})`).

senders.what: The `auth` handler, after a successful login. `players[socket.id]` must still be this character and the socket must be connected.
